narrative.coaching_note: Clean your hands after touching bed rail A or call button before you touch phone. You touched bed rail A at 0.5 seconds with your bare hand, and that spread to call button at 3.4 seconds. You then touched phone at 6.6 seconds, which moved it from the patient area to your healthcare area item. You missed cleaning for Moment 5 after contact at 5.8 seconds, and again with your gloved hand at 18.7 seconds. At the end, your bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button and phone were still carrying it. Next time, clean your hands before putting gloves on at 10.9 seconds and keep your gloved hand off phone, which you touched at 19.3 seconds. Alcohol rub works against MRSA for cleaning your hands at these moments.
